scenarios.title: Fast check rate limited, no time to retry (fail open)
scenarios.description: F1. support-bot (flag, deadline 600 ms, no hedge). mock-upstream answers the decision request 429 with Retry-After 1 s (429@1). The wait does not fit the 600 ms deadline, so the client gives up: status error:retryable, degraded error, one attempt. A flag route fails open: the answer passes unchanged, verdict unknown, no risk. The deep audit samples every failed check on the demo routes (error_sample_rate 1.0): two SUPPORTED claims, GROUNDED.
